text: rename the "leave free floating" in graph aim creation flow to "leave uncommitted".
description:
terminology: 
no parent => root aim
no phase => uncommmitted
no parent, no phase => free floating

status.comment: Implemented and internally verified; awaiting UI wording acceptance.

reflection: Renamed both graph-creation phase-skip options from “leave floating” to “leave uncommitted.” Their existing descriptions already correctly state that no phase commitment is created. “No supported aim” remains the separate root/parent relation choice. Verification: list-store tests 4/4, frontend production build/type-check, repository search confirms no remaining “leave floating” labels, and git diff --check passed.
